name: Kiran P K
aboutBrief: Backend-focused software engineer building and owning production systems across fintech and SaaS — shipping features, reducing tech debt, and building the infrastructure growing teams need.
paragraphs: At every company I've joined, I've taken ownership beyond my role. At GeoServes I inherited an acquired platform with no tests and no clear architecture — rebuilt it end-to-end in six months, introduced unit testing standards with Jest and dependency injection, and now own backend delivery and production monitoring across two products.

At Dexif I owned the entire Postgres layer across four fintech products — schema design, migrations, Row-Level Security policies, RPC functions — while shipping features against stock exchange integration deadlines. At SuperHire I grew from intern to SDE-L2, led a team of five, built CI/CD pipelines that cut deploy time by 50% and increased release frequency by 75%, and set up observability with Grafana and Prometheus.

My stack is Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, and AWS, with production Golang experience. I'm most useful in teams that are past the prototype stage and need engineers who can own a domain, improve what exists, and ship reliably.
